fullDesc: The Treaty of Versailles was signed on June 28, 1919. It made Germany accept blame for the war, pay reparations and give up territory. Many Germans resented it, and it fed the rise of extremist politics.
realFacts: The League of Nations was created
Germany's army was limited to 100,000 men
The US Senate refused to ratify it
Economist John Maynard Keynes criticised it as too harsh
